name: libhdhomerun
desc: C library for controlling SiliconDust HDHomeRun TV tuners
why: Talks to network TV tuners over a custom protocol; a close call that needs hardware to be interesting.

brief.what_it_is: A C library that implements SiliconDust's HDHomeRun protocol for controlling HDHomeRun network TV tuners. It builds two things: the libhdhomerun library, whose top-level API is hdhomerun_device, and the hdhomerun_config command-line utility, which the README says is for sending commands to or scripting control of a HDHomeRun. The input is a network-attached tuner; the output is control of that device and its data.
brief.why_it_exists: The README gives no stated motivation. It describes the project as a library implementing the libhdhomerun protocol for use with SiliconDust HDHomeRun TV tuners.
brief.how_it_works: The README does not explain the mechanism. It names the top-level API as hdhomerun_device, documented in hdhomerun_device.h, and says the build compiles the library and the hdhomerun_config utility. Protocol details are not in the README.

commands_seen.context: Building from the source tree: the README says a plain make compiles both the library and the hdhomerun_config command-line utility.

brief.install_notes: The README gives only a build step: run make. It lists extra libraries: pthread on OSX, Linux and BSD, and iphlpapi on Windows. The brew formula's executable is hdhomerun_config. Using it needs an HDHomeRun tuner on the network; the README does not describe first-run setup or configuration.
brief.standout: It talks to network TV tuners over SiliconDust's own protocol, so the tool is only meaningful with the physical hardware attached. The scout note calls it a close call that needs hardware to be interesting. The scout's view, not the README's.
brief.status: unknown. The README has a copyright line of 2005-2023 and no release or last-commit date was visible in what I fetched. I did not check the repository's commit history or releases.
brief.caveats: The Homebrew formula's homepage (silicondust.com/support/linux/) returned HTTP 404, so the official page was unreachable. I used the GitHub repository at github.com/Silicondust/libhdhomerun instead; I guessed that URL from the library name rather than taking it from the formula, so confirm it is the official source. The README is short: no usage examples, no license text, no protocol description. Windows needs iphlpapi. The library needs a real HDHomeRun tuner to do anything useful.
quotes: This library implements the libhdhomerun protocol for use with Silicondust HDHomeRun TV tuners.
To compile simply "make" - this will compile both the library and the hdhomerun_config command line utility suitable for sending commands or scripting control of a HDHomeRun.
The top level API is hdhomerun_device - see hdhomerun_device.h for documentation.
